name: 8859-longdecode-llama31gguf8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90) of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1: one in-process vLLM engine on one GPU.
architecture: Llama-3.1-8B in GGUF v3: 32 blocks, hidden 4096, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, ffn 14336; native window 131072, cut to 4096 by `max-model-len`.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1, bounded at 50 requests / 2400 s safety, warmup the first 10% by completion (discarded from the statistics, still sent).
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix bucket, faker-generated prose. Prompt exactly 16 tokens and output exactly 512 (min = max on both), greedy, `ignore_eos`. `request_format: plain` keeps the wire prompt at the declared 16; the chat-template path would make it 50 and would not run on this engine's tokenizer wrapper.
purpose: A long-form story generator expanding short prompts into 512-token passages for one user at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit 4f95ffee6f40198911ee824ed06d645fe9678511 (v0.6.2-era EngineArgs): an unknown key
# is a TypeError at engine construction, so do not add flags from a later vLLM.
# `quantization` and `load-format` are deliberately absent: both are forced to `gguf` by the
# engine itself once the model path is recognised as GGUF.

# Served by PATH -- GGUF is recognised from the file's magic bytes, not from a repo id.
model: ${SYSAGENT_HF_HOME}/hub/models--bartowski--Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-GGUF/snapshots/bf5b95e96dac0462e2a09145ec66cae9a3f12067/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-IQ4_XS.gguf

# The ungated mirror of `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` (Llama 3.1 Community License).
tokenizer: unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

max-model-len: 4096
tensor-parallel-size: 1
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# KV capacity pinned to a fixed block count: 4096 blocks x 16 tokens = 65536 tokens = 8 GiB,
# against a working set of one request of at most 528 tokens. A control, not an operating
# parameter -- without it the block count is whatever memory profiling leaves over.
num-gpu-blocks-override: 4096

# Engine defaults at this commit, written down so they cannot drift.
block-size: 16
max-num-seqs: 256
